request:
How many public classes, public module-level functions and public methods are defined in the non-test code of the auto_ontology/retrieval/kumo/ package (files under its tests/ folder excluded)? A name is public when it does not start with an underscore, so dunder methods such as __init__ are not public, and methods of a class whose name starts with an underscore are not public either. Nested functions and nested classes are not counted. Return one row per kind, with kind being 'class', 'function' or 'method'.

Requested output columns: kind (string), public_count (integer).
explanation: The query counts public symbols of each kind (class, function, method) from non-test files in the auto_ontology/retrieval/kumo/ package, excluding files under any tests/ directory and excluding symbols whose name starts with an underscore (including dunder methods). It uses the code.symbols table filtered by kind, is_public, and file_id conditions to ensure only top-level, non-test, public definitions are counted.
sql: SELECT 'class' AS kind, COUNT(*) AS public_count FROM code.symbols WHERE kind = 'class' AND is_public = TRUE AND file_id NOT IN (SELECT file_id FROM code.files WHERE is_test = TRUE) AND file_id NOT LIKE '%/tests/%' AND name NOT LIKE '_%' UNION ALL SELECT 'function' AS kind, COUNT(*) AS public_count FROM code.symbols WHERE kind = 'function' AND is_public = TRUE AND file_id NOT IN (SELECT file_id FROM code.files WHERE is_test = TRUE) AND file_id NOT LIKE '%/tests/%' AND name NOT LIKE '_%' UNION ALL SELECT 'method' AS kind, COUNT(*) AS public_count FROM code.symbols WHERE kind = 'method' AND is_public = TRUE AND file_id NOT IN (SELECT file_id FROM code.files WHERE is_test = TRUE) AND file_id NOT LIKE '%/tests/%' AND name NOT LIKE '_%' ORDER BY kind
